items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...His brother still plays John Joseph. John Joseph. [INTERVIEWEE] That's the bass player.

ctx.x: Yeah well I knew Mutt too. Mutt came down, I mean when I was working on Alamo and Mutt came down one or two times I think. I was working on Alamo with Kaizer. Remember Kaizer?
Oh yes. The Willie Joseph. Willie Joseph. His brother still plays John Joseph. John Joseph.
